derived_from: Provider reconnaissance captures of 1 August 2026 (open web), 4 August 2026 (Redpine, the first licensed fetch) and the re-verification captures of 5 September 2026 (Parallel, Linkup, Keenable, You.com, Nimble and Tavily fetch, made by the committed `demo/jobs/recon-w3c-prov-*.json` jobs) — see README.md. This manifest is derived from those captures and names which of them a --replay run serves; the captures themselves are unchanged evidence. Redpine's acquisition is five recorded legs behind one routed origin, named by the capability column.
